as_told.title: Department of War UAP file drop forces Isaacman admission

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jared Isaacman, the current head of NASA, the US space agency, has admitted that some UFO cases are unresolved. In a later episode Michels says this came after the Department of War, the name now used for the Defense Department, released a first batch of files on space exploration and astronaut encounters. As Michels tells it, Isaacman said this was not about reverse engineering UFOs or confirmed alien bodies, but that the sightings were unexplained, which Michels calls a huge update.
